content.title: Kodiak AI debuts via SPAC deal. CEO discusses its driverless trucks.
content.description:
Kodiak AI (KDK) began publicly trading on the Nasdaq via a SPAC deal (Special Purpose Acquisition Company) on Thursday. Autonomous trucking startup Kodiak Robotics merged with Ares Acquisition Corp. II (AACT) to form the new company.

Kodiak AI founder and CEO Don Burnette joins Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman for a conversation about the company's driverless trucking technology and customer base.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
